description:
No one’s coming to save you.

Good.

Because the day you stop waiting is the day your life changes.

No one owes you an opportunity.
No one owes you success.
No one owes you a second chance.

Every win is earned.
Every failure is a lesson.
Every result has your fingerprints on it.

That’s not bad news.

It’s the most empowering truth you’ll ever accept.

The moment you own everything, you gain the power to change anything.
transcript: And no one is coming to save you. No one owes you shit. When you accept that no one owes you anything in life, that it's all on you, fight for independence. Fight to know that no one's coming to save you, that it's on you, that you're not owed shit.
spoken_hook_0_3s: And no one is coming to save you.
